questions.prompt: Anita ___ to school on foot every day. (A go, B goes, C going, D went)
steps: Anita is singular and every day signals a present habit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She is ___ an apple at the moment. (A eats, B eat, C eating, D are eating)
steps: Is eating is present continuous; adding are would give two auxiliaries.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: They ___ football yesterday. (A play, B played, C plays, D playing)
steps: Yesterday calls for the regular past tense.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Elia likes playing football ___ volleyball. (A but, B of, C and, D with)
steps: And joins the two sports.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Samwel said 'That is his pencil'. Give it to ___. (A him, B me, C them, D we)
steps: Use the object pronoun him for the male owner after to.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Mr. Lazaro grows maize, beans and cassava. He is a ___. (A farmer, B pastoralist, C doctor, D teacher)
steps: Growing crops is farming.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Joseph, my brother's father, is also my ___. (A uncle, B brother, C father, D cousin)
steps: Siblings ordinarily share a father, though half-sibling families require more information.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Were pupils ___ English last evening? (A learn, B learns, C learning, D learned)
steps: Were plus the -ing form makes past continuous.

questions.prompt: Visit the ___ where your son can get treatment. (A church, B market, C hospital, D shop)
steps: A hospital provides medical treatment.

questions.prompt: The ___ is good today. (weather, whether)
steps: Weather names conditions such as sunshine or rain.

questions.prompt: He was very ___ because of illness. (week, weak)

questions.prompt: The teacher has ___ us to go for sports. (aloud, allowed)

questions.prompt: They have powers to ___ sick people. (heel, heal)

questions.prompt: The dog wags its ___. (tale, tail)

questions.prompt: Christians usually go to church on ___ (Sunyad).

questions.prompt: We always ___ lessons at 8:00 AM (trats).

questions.prompt: Pupils are planting ___ around school (swerfol).

questions.prompt: Deborah is ___ cleanliness. (do)
steps: Add ing to do after is.

questions.prompt: Ally is busy ___ television. (watch)

questions.prompt: Their father is ___ after chickens. (look)
